scope: Four norway_4_lv_grids only; industrial data is not processed.
Multiple consumers on one physical bus are summed separately for P and Q.
No source data is modified, no neural network is trained, and no test metric is calculated.

metric_definitions.smape: mean(2 * abs(error) / (abs(actual) + abs(predicted))) * 100 over nonzero denominators
metric_definitions.autocorrelation: Pearson correlation between x[t] and x[t-lag] on finite pairs

quality_definition.series: sum of P profiles and sum of Q profiles per mapped physical bus
quality_definition.stats_use: finite values only; invalid values are counted and not imputed

assessment_basis: finite baseline metrics on validation pairs
no NaN/Inf quality values on physical buses
no undefined or near-zero WAPE denominator
